_comment: Reviewed original local-vars that no op assigns on the PC port, zero-filled at entry on Dreamcast (AI-assisted). Each entry names the function, its locals and why. Anything not listed still refuses as an uninitialized read. lower_sh4_ir.py --unassigned-locals checks every listed local exists and is never assigned; build_game_cgo.py reports entries no file used.
